name: comparade26-build-tools
description: Build tools, vendored: node_modules is committed so the build needs no npm and no network. To change a version, edit it here, run `npm install --omit=dev --ignore-scripts` IN A COPY of this folder (npm prunes what the lockfile does not list, and roadroller - from a git fork, see its VENDORED.md - is not in it), then copy back the changed packages and the lockfile, without node_modules/.bin, and commit. esbuild and google-closure-compiler-windows are native Windows x64 executables.
